period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)' / 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (lines 290-451), distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing (lines 6-233). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Real extracted text (pdftotext), no image-reading needed. Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2024' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Apr to Jun 2024' column (interest income 13,094,942,288; PAT 2,469,633,020; EPS 1.40) not recorded here, kept for a future finer-grained pass. One value required inference: the source's 'Affordable housing bond' row (note 10.1) was split by pdftotext across two garbled lines ('...10.1  4,751,000,000' then a stray '-  4,751,000,000' on the next line) instead of one clean 'current | comparative' row. Resolved as 4,751,000,000 for both 30-Jun-2024 and 31-Dec-2023 (i.e. unchanged), based on: (a) the immediately preceding quarter's filing (bracbank-q1-2024.txt) shows this same bond flat at 4,751,000,000 for both 31-Mar-2024 and 31-Dec-2023; (b) with this value, the five liability components (58,549,914,285 + 57,656,682,634 + 4,751,000,000 + 1,709,000,000 + 1,652,000,000 = 124,318,596,919) plus deposits (588,279,527,589) plus other liabilities (42,231,247,484) sum to exactly 754,829,371,992 = reported Total liabilities, with no residual — strong internal confirmation. Balance sheet identity reconciles essentially exactly: asset components sum to 822,819,725,172 = reported Total property and assets; liabilities+equity (754,829,371,992 + 67,990,353,179) = 822,819,725,171, a 1-Taka rounding difference. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII+Investment income+Commission+Other operating income=Total operating income to within BDT1; less opex=profit before provisions; less provision=PBT exactly; less tax=PAT exactly). Comparative (31 Dec 2023) Total shareholders' equity of 63,782,029,290 matches this bank's own 2023_Q4-adjacent figures with no restatement observed. Capital/asset-quality ratios below are the Solo ('BRAC Bank PLC.') column of the filing's own Annexure-A 'Highlights on the overall activities' table (lines 2211-2253), which corroborates the balance-sheet figures exactly (paid-up capital, total assets, total deposits, total loans and advances all tie out precisely to the balance sheet). ROA, ROI and ROE in that table are explicitly labelled by the source as annualized (simple x2 of the half-year figure, per the source's own footnote), not raw half-year returns. 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is the only such subtotal line in the solo P&L (no separate 'Operating profit' line above it), so per this bank's established convention for solo statements lacking a distinct operating-profit line (see 2016_Q2.json, 2023_Q2.json) it is recorded here as operating_profit_cumulative. The equity sub-reserves 'Dividend equalization fund', 'Revaluation reserve on govt. securities', 'Fair value gain/(loss) on equity investment' and 'Foreign currency translation reserve' were visible on the balance sheet but, per this bank's established convention, are not recorded as separate line items (only the four standard components + total are captured).
